messages:
olivia: Quick ping — can someone eyeball this TF PR before I merge? https://git.redwood.com/redwood/infra/pull/1023
olivia: It's adding an ENI attach for the new gpu-pool nodes; plan shows a new aws_network_interface and a route table change. Hoping to land today if no blockers.
matt: I can take a look in ~30m, thanks for the heads up.
raj: Quick question — did you run the plan in staging already? curious about security group drift handling.
olivia: Ran plan+apply in staging, no failures. Plan excerpt:
```
resource "aws_network_interface" "gpu_eni" {
  subnet_id   = aws_subnet.gpu.id
  private_ips = [aws_instance.gpu_prod.private_ip]

  attachment {
    instance     = aws_instance.gpu_prod.id
    device_index = 1
  }
}
```
jen: :eyes: main concern is IPAM / ENI lifecycle during node replacement. If autoscaler churns, we could leak ENIs unless detach is handled.
eng-sre-bot: no active incidents in us-west-2
matt: Two quick asks: 1) add explicit tags so our cleanup job can find these ENIs; 2) consider `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on the nic attachment or explicit detach logic in the scale-down hook.
raj: I can help add the tag + adjust lifecycle in a follow-up commit. also let's add a tfplan CI check that ensures route-table modifications are intentional.
olivia: Will add tags and the lifecycle tweak, and open a tiny CI test. Should I hold the merge until you both sign off? ETA ~2h for the edits.
matt: Hold please. Ping me when updates are pushed and CI is green.
jen: small nit — subnet tag `redwood:gpu` isn't present in the change; discovery relies on it, please include.
olivia: adding that tag in the next commit, thanks.
ci-bot: Terraform plan for PR #1023: success — no unexpected diffs against staging.
matt: LGTM after the commits & CI. Approving now. :white_check_mark:
olivia: thanks all — will push the fixes and ping when ready to merge.
